expo.name: PAPA RENT
expo.description: Alle sociale huur en middenhuur van Nederland in één app — melding binnen seconden na publicatie.

infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Vergrendel PAPA RENT met Face ID, zodat alleen jij je radars en meldingen ziet.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PAPA RENT gebruikt je locatie alleen als je in de radar-assistent op “Bij mij in de buurt” tikt, om het middelpunt van je zoekgebied te bepalen. We bewaren alleen dat ene punt — afgerond op ongeveer 100 meter — als middelpunt van je Radar, en volgen je nooit op de achtergrond.

setup.readme: JSON has no comments, so the open setup steps live here. Every value starting with REPLACE_ME is a placeholder, and the example.com domains and com.example.paparent identifiers must be replaced with your own. The app treats a REPLACE_ME projectId as 'not configured' (src/lib/config.ts) and therefore registers no push token.
setup.owner: Expo account name (organisation or user) that owns the EAS project. See expo.dev → Account settings.
setup.extra.eas.projectId: Set by `eas init` in apps/mobile. Then put the same UUID in expo.updates.url (https://u.expo.dev/<projectId>).
setup.androidAppLinks: autoVerify only works once https://example.com/.well-known/assetlinks.json and the same file on app.example.com contain the SHA-256 of the Play signing key (`eas credentials` shows it).
setup.iosUniversalLinks: associatedDomains only works once https://example.com/.well-known/apple-app-site-association (and app.example.com) contains appID <TeamID>.com.example.paparent.
setup.permissions: Only what the app really uses: internet + network state (API), POST_NOTIFICATIONS + VIBRATE + RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED (housing alerts), USE_BIOMETRIC (app lock). USE_FINGERPRINT is added by expo-local-authentication for Android < 9 and therefore stays. Location (ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION + NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription) is only requested when the user taps “Bij mij in de buurt” in the radar wizard: never at startup, never in the background. Coarse enough for a 5 km radius; we deliberately do not ask for fine GPS permission. The point read is rounded in the app to 3 decimals (~110 m) and then stored as the radar centre (radars.center_lat/center_lng). That is what the permission text says and what privacy statement §3 describes; say the same in the App Store privacy nutrition labels (Coarse Location, linked to the account, App Functionality only).
setup.blockedPermissions: Added by libraries but unused: ACCESS_WIFI_STATE (expo-network, not used), READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (Glide via expo-image, we read no local files), SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW (debug template).
setup.allowBackup: Off: the session token lives in SecureStore and does not belong in a Google Drive backup. The account lives on the server, so nothing is lost.
